$comment: E-058 S2a/S2b (delivery_plan_v26.md slice 6a; engineering/roadmap/E-058/S1_FINDINGS.md §3). Applied at write time: tools/campaign_memory.py::upsert_memory passes the whole document to tools/workflow_artifact_validation.validate_workflow_artifact, which picks this file by the target's stem (campaign_memory) like every schema in this directory -- warn-only by default, blocking only under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise. tests/test_e058_s2a_regroup_record.py also validates real stage output against it strictly. Entries are closed (additionalProperties: false) so a retired field (hypothesis_family, altitude, lineage_routing, continuation_*) cannot creep in. Two entry forms: a full entry, and a fault-only entry for a run with component errors.
title: campaign_record/campaign_memory.yaml
description: Per-run campaign memory written by the regroup_record stage (orchestrator.regroup_record.enabled). One entry per run_id, replaced on re-run. Runs before the stage are not listed (legacy history: campaign_knowledge_base.yaml).

fault_entry.description: A run with component errors: only the fact of the fault. Its grid, variants and proposals are not parsed (tools/campaign_memory.py::build_fault_entry).

forecast_hash.description: Copied from the variant's campaign_state.trial_sharpes row (a tested variant must have one); null for not_tested. Not the trading-bot run artifact's config hash (reporting/run_artifact.py), which uses compact separators.

n_windows.description: Distinct walk-forward windows (not symbol x window rows).

windows_sha256.description: E-062 S2b-3c (D-047 (5)): OPTIONAL. A partial-coverage per-coin variant's own window fingerprint (tools/novelty.windows_fingerprint of its protocol.json windows), copied from its trial row, which carries it only when written under orchestrator.profit_bars_v2. The repeat key (tools/novelty.novelty_key) uses it in place of the protocol's window hash. Absent: the variant keys on the protocol's windows, exactly as before.

skipped.description: E-068 slice 5: the reader was not called (a code skip rule) or its answer was refused after its retry; present only then.

proposals.description: References only -- scores are never copied (they rank candidates in slice 6b).

registry.description: E-058 S2b (tools/block_registry.py): block_ids registered in campaign_record/block_registry.yaml by this run, or why none was: not_validated (idea_status is not validated), no_manifest (validated, but artifacts/block_manifest.yaml is absent) or composition (E-060 S3b: a composition run -- a composite never registers as a block).

profit_bars.description: Branch 3 on every backtest (orchestrator.profit_bars_every_backtest.enabled, tools/campaign_memory.py::profit_bars_block): one profit-bars result per variant from artifacts/profit_bars_evaluation.yaml. null when that check is off (then profit_bars_reason says why). Never decides idea_status.

profit_bars_reason.description: null exactly when profit_bars is filled (enforced by build_memory_entry and by the allOf rule on this entry).

kb_entry_id.description: E-058 S2b (tools/grid_kb_writer.py): id of this run's entry in campaign_knowledge_base.yaml (legacy_schema: false); null only when the KB file does not exist (the entry is then skipped with a loud log line, like the legacy writer).

finding.description: E-068 slice 4 (tools/claim_findings.py), OPTIONAL: present only when orchestrator.claim_tests.enabled is on. The run's claim, whether its tests see the block, its scope and the measured effect sizes per variant (detail by reference to claim_test.yaml). Information only (D-055): it never bans, routes or stops anything. Deliberately loose below the top level so a finding can never make the memory write fail.

result.description: PASS when any tested variant passes every bar.
INVALIDATED: tested on this attempt but its trial row is invalidated_artifact (conformance) -- never graded, never passing.
